tier3_dispersion.description: Calculates 1/d^2 decay for a point source.
tier3_dispersion.template: WITH stack AS (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lon}, {lat}), 4326) AS geom) SELECT b.building_id AS sector, DEGREES(ST_Azimuth(s.geom, ST_Centroid(b.geometry))) AS azimuth_deg, 1.0 / GREATEST(POWER(ST_Distance(b.geometry::geography, s.geom::geography)/100.0, 2), 1.0) AS decay_factor FROM rails_north.vulnerability_profile_{site_name} b CROSS JOIN stack s;

tier3_wind_anchor.description: Fetches wind array for nearest grid point.
tier3_wind_anchor.template: SELECT wind_direction_timeseries FROM rails_north.climate_wind_grid_{site_name} ORDER BY ST_Distance(geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lon}, {lat}), 4326)) LIMIT 1;
